text:
I'm 56 years old and very timid. I went to the dentist and the dentist had a very gentle touch. I decided to get dental implants at Masterdent Dental Clinic, Talad Kosum branch. The procedure took 20 minutes and I was able to drive home by myself. On the first day, I applied a cold compress to my cheek to help reduce swelling. The dentist gave me anti-inflammatory and painkillers. I only took one dose because it wasn't painful and I didn't need to take time off work.
During that time, I was able to eat and clean my mouth as usual. After 7 days, the dentist scheduled me to remove my stitches, which didn't hurt at all. Three months later, the dentist scheduled me for an X-ray before the implant.
I can confirm that dental implants are not painful or scary. The tightness in my cheeks disappeared within 24 hours.

The staff and doctors at Masterdent Dental Clinic provided excellent advice. The cost of dental implants is paid in installments; you don't need to pay in one lump sum.
